🇨🇮 "#Juventus continues working to close the signing of Franck #Kessié, maintaining contacts with the player's agents.In the last 24 hours, the main point of discussion has been the contract signing bonus and other conditions linked to the agreement.#Kessié has been waiting for #Juve for almost three months and he wants to play for the club.He respects #Juve and maintains his desire to go to Turin.#Juventus hoped to close the agreement yesterday evening, but it was not possible.The club continued working on the deal throughout the day today.There is no reason to sound the alarm; a positive outlook is maintained regarding the chances of the deal reaching a successful conclusion.Luciano #Spall

👀 "Luciano #Spalletti would have been satisfied with #Milik during the pre-season.There is a possibility that the Polish striker will remain at #Juventus as a third attacking option, sending #Ekhator out on loan.His technical characteristics have been highlighted, although there is a major doubt on his physical condition: he only played 20 minutes in an official match over the last 22 months.#Juve has received 2 or 3 requests from Serie A clubs for Jeff #Ekhator, in addition to interest from abroad.#Juventus would be considering letting him go on loan so he can have a season with many minutes, potentially as a starter, and return more prepared next year."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

AGREEMENT WITH BEŞIKTAŞ FOR THE DISPOSALOF THE PLAYER MIRETTITurin, 28 August 2026 – Juventus Football Club S.p.A. announces that an agreement with Beşiktaş JK for thetemporary disposal, until 30 June 2027, of the registration rights of the player Fabio Miretti has been reached for aconsideration of € 2 million, with ancillary costs of € 0.1 million.The agreement further entails the right for Beşiktaş to definitively acquire the player’s registration rights for anadditional consideration of € 13 million, payable in three financial years.
